02

The standard

Platinum is not a colour.
It's a discipline.

Anybody can lighten hair. I take clients all the way to platinum — and keep the hair standing when we get there. My whole system is built on one belief: taking your clients to platinum takes patience, precision, and a plan. No rushing the lift, no guessing the tone, no praying at the bowl.

From my chair in Largo to seminar stages in Dallas and an international tour, I teach the exact process I use every day — and I hold my own work to the same standard I teach.

04

The platinum process

Four phases.
No shortcuts.

Phase 01 — First

Consult & plan

We look at your hair's history, its strength and where it can honestly go. Platinum starts with a plan — never with a guess.

Phase 02 — The lift

Saturation

Every strand coated, every section even. This is where flawless blondes are made — or lost.

“Saturation is KEY to achieving a flawless blonde.”

Phase 03 — The wait

Patience

The lift takes the time it takes. I watch it, I check it, and I don't pull it early because a clock — or a client — is impatient.

Phase 04 — The reveal

Tone & finish

The tone is where platinum becomes platinum: icy, clean, even. Then the cut, the finish, and the mirror moment.

Foils, saturation checks, strand tests — the unglamorous details are the whole difference between blonde and platinum.
